title: Mother and Daughter, Rocky California Coast - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A touching outdoor portrait of a young mother smiling warmly while carrying her young daughter along an elevated rocky coastal ledge. The mother sports a 1940s victory-style curl hairstyle and is dressed in a dark wool overcoat with a patterned scarf tucked inside. The child wears a dark plush velvet coat, hair ribbon, and Mary Jane shoes. The shimmering surface of the sea extends into the horizon behind them under a bright, blown-out sky, capturing an intimate moment of post-war domestic family leisure.
